title: Add links to other movie sites on IMDb
question: How do I jump from an IMDb page to Letterboxd, Rotten Tomatoes or TMDb?
answer: IMDb title pages do not link to Letterboxd, TMDb or Rotten Tomatoes. The usermods script on this page adds a row of links under the title: Letterboxd and TMDb open the same film directly from its IMDb id, and Rotten Tomatoes, Metacritic and Wikipedia open a search for the title. Without an extension, Letterboxd accepts IMDb ids in its URL: replace the start of the IMDb address with letterboxd.com/imdb/ and keep the tt number.
prompt: On IMDb title pages, add links to the same movie on Letterboxd, TMDb, Rotten Tomatoes, Metacritic and Wikipedia.
details: The links are built from the page itself: the `tt` id in the address, the title in the heading and the year in the page's structured data. The script sends no requests. Letterboxd (`letterboxd.com/imdb/<id>/`) and TMDb (`themoviedb.org/redirect?external_source=imdb_id&external_id=<id>`) redirect to their page for that id; Letterboxd only lists films, so its link fails for TV series. The other three are searches, so a common title may need a second click. Links open in a new tab. Only the main title page (`/title/tt.../`) gets the row; cast, reviews and other sub-pages do not.

alternatives.title: Letterboxd and TMDb by IMDb id
alternatives.body: Open `https://letterboxd.com/imdb/tt0111161/` or `https://www.themoviedb.org/redirect?external_source=imdb_id&external_id=tt0111161` with the id from the IMDb address.

check.baseline: (() => { const h = document.querySelector('h1[data-testid="hero__pageTitle"]'); return !!h && h.checkVisibility() && /Shawshank/.test(h.textContent) && !document.querySelector('a[href*="letterboxd.com"], a[href*="themoviedb.org"], a[href*="rottentomatoes.com"]'); })()
check.expect: (() => { const row = document.querySelector('.usermods-ext-links'); if (!row || !row.checkVisibility()) return false; const hrefs = [...row.querySelectorAll('a')].filter((a) => a.checkVisibility()).map((a) => a.href); return hrefs.length === 5 && hrefs.includes('https://letterboxd.com/imdb/tt0111161/') && hrefs.some((u) => u.includes('themoviedb.org/redirect') && u.includes('external_id=tt0111161')) && hrefs.some((u) => u.startsWith('https://www.rottentomatoes.com/search?search=The%20Shawshank%20Redemption')) && hrefs.some((u) => u.includes('wikipedia.org') && u.includes('1994')); })()
check.intact: (() => { const h = document.querySelector('h1[data-testid="hero__pageTitle"]'); const poster = document.querySelector('[data-testid="hero-media__poster"]'); const cast = document.querySelector('[data-testid="title-cast"]'); return !!h && h.checkVisibility() && !!poster && poster.checkVisibility() && !!cast && cast.checkVisibility(); })()
